name: Ben Clarke
source: The owner of a bookstore in the town of Lind, an encounter with a mysterious bracelet triggers his transformation into the first vampire. The bracelet seizes on Ben’s dark fantasies, giving rise to the vampires now spreading through Lind. Their forms are shaped by his desires, each bearing the mark of his imagination. With a hunger for more than blood, he sets out to spread the infection. He becomes the origin of every tale of corruption and darkness overtaking the town.
